notes.title: Important announcement about the game expansions!
notes.content:
[h1]So.... How do I start?
[/h1]
Before Dark was a great learning experience for me to know my way around the unity engine, but alas, I am not very proud of the game. I liked working on it and the learning process, but it was definitely not something that I had planned from the very start.

Therefore, I have something important to say, I am now working on a new game that uses the same characters as Before Dark. It is way bigger and way more intricate than anything I had done already.

The game is called Neon Night, and I have no set release date for it, but it is starting development already!

[h1]Now, I also wanted to mention the DLCs[/h1]

Before was supposed to have two free DLCs released for it. Unfortunately, those DLCs are no longer considered. Instead, I'll be focusing on the new game and releasing that instead. Before Dark will receive no more updates.

Thank you for reading!
